categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in residential and building development, including the sale of residential properties and buildings, civil engineering and construction contracting, and property leasing. The majority of revenue comes from residential property sales, with additional income from construction services and rental operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction techniques such as the unique SI method (Skeleton & Infill structure) with separated interior design systems. It focuses on high-performance residential designs emphasizing durability, environmental friendliness, universal design, and health. Quality control is maintained through strict contractor selection and three-tier engineering supervision.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The main customers are individual homebuyers and companies in the Greater Taipei area, particularly targeting first-time homebuyers and owner-occupiers. The company’s projects cater to residential demand with a focus on mid-to-small sized units, addressing market needs for affordable and quality housing.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in the Greater Taipei metropolitan area, including Taipei City and New Taipei City, with some expansion plans toward Taoyuan and other metropolitan regions in central and southern Taiwan. The company’s projects are primarily urban residential developments within these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, property development, construction management, and sales. It also controls a construction subsidiary to manage building execution, ensuring quality and cost control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-performance, differentiated residential products with a focus on sustainability, health, and comfort. The company emphasizes innovation in construction methods and materials, market-driven product positioning, and expanding urban renewal projects. R&D focuses on green building technologies and enhancing construction efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of residential properties and buildings. Additional income streams include construction contracting fees and rental income from property leasing. The company also invests in related subsidiaries to support its core business operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other branded construction firms in the Greater Taipei area, holding a market share below 1% in Taipei City. It differentiates itself through strong brand reputation, quality construction, and strategic land acquisition. Competitors include other established residential developers with urban renewal capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$4.68 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 10.31% growth over the prior year. Net profit after tax increased by 6.57% to about NT$686 million. The company maintains a stable financial structure with a debt-to-asset ratio below 50% and continues to improve profitability and cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, high-performance residential buildings that incorporate sustainability, health, and universal design principles. It leverages unique construction technologies and rigorous quality control to create differentiated products. Strong brand recognition and customer trust in the Greater Taipei market underpin its competitive advantage.
